summary: Generate Atlas edition button silently produces nothing — reasoning-model default burns full token budget on reasoning, returns empty essay (HTTP 500, no row)

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Reproduced end-to-end via 'npx tsx scripts/atlas.ts --force'. Default model deepseek-v4-pro (reasoning) with the atlas prompt (~29,700 input tokens; buildAtlasPrompt filled the 32k pro window with source-passage bodies) returned finish_reason=length, completion_tokens=8192 all reasoning_tokens, content=0 chars. MIN_BODY_CHARS guard throws -> route 500 -> no blog_posts row inserted. UI shows only a tiny error string; ~$0.03 billed per failed click.

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Two defects: (1) reasoning model can never emit content on this prompt at an 8192 shared budget; (2) generateAtlasEdition throws instead of leaving a visible row, so failures vanish. Fix (implemented, uncommitted): atlas defaults to a cheap non-reasoning model (ATLAS_DEFAULT_SLUG='google'); source passages capped (ATLAS_PASSAGE_TOKEN_BUDGET=4000) shrinking prompt ~29.7k->12.2k tokens; on empty generation land a needs_attention row instead of throwing into the void. Verified: real draft at $0.02, tsc + 15 atlas tests green. Test added in atlas-generate.test.ts.

resolution.test_function: parks a needs_attention row when the model returns an empty body
resolution.note: Fixed: cheap non-reasoning atlas default (ATLAS_DEFAULT_SLUG='google'), source-passage cap (prompt ~29.7k->12.2k tokens), and needs_attention row on empty generation. Verified real draft at ~$0.02.
